comment: Global name-collision groups that exist today but cannot break a run (scripts/check-name-collisions.py --quiet). Every entry must name the exact module set, the reason the declarations cannot be loaded in one program, an owner and an expires date. An expired entry is an error; so is a stale entry whose group has disappeared. Prefer renaming the declaration or removing the entry over renewing it. A module here is a repository-relative .wiz path; module and modules identify the same set (module is the primary path).

entries.name: Goal
entries.reason: project-wide only: lib/Infoview.wiz (the infoview protocol) and selfhost/Frontend.wiz (the self-hosted frontend) are independent programs. Neither imports the other, transitively, and no scanned module imports both, so Goal cannot be loaded twice in one run.

entries.name: Q
entries.reason: project-wide only: lib/Rat.wiz (the rationals' structure Q) and selfhost/Kernel.wiz (the self-hosted kernel's inductive Q) are independent. There is no import path either way and no scanned module imports both.

entries.name: Scry.boolD
entries.reason: project-wide only: scry/src/Scry/Codegen.wiz (the schema generator) and scry/src/Scry/Facts.wiz (the fact-store loader) are separate tools. Neither imports the other, transitively, and no scanned module imports both.

entries.name: Scry.dedup
entries.reason: project-wide only: scry/src/Scry/Codegen.wiz (the schema generator) and scry/src/Scry/Lower.wiz (C to Wil) have no import path between them and no common scanned importer, so the two dedup functions cannot meet in one run.
entries.owner: Scry schema tooling (scry/src/Scry/Codegen.wiz) and the C frontend (scry/src/Scry/Lower.wiz)

entries.name: Step
entries.reason: project-wide only: lib/Grail.wiz (the tactic framework) and selfhost/Frontend.wiz (the self-hosted frontend) are independent: neither imports the other and no scanned module imports both.

entries.name: branches
entries.reason: project-wide only: selfhost/Cof.wiz is not in the self-hosted compiler's module graph with selfhost/Frontend.wiz. There is no import path between them and no common scanned importer, so neither branches function is loaded by the other's program.
entries.owner: Self-hosted Cof (selfhost/Cof.wiz) and the self-hosted frontend (selfhost/Frontend.wiz)

entries.name: check
entries.reason: project-wide only: lib/Scry/AiFixpoint.wiz (the fixpoint analysis) and selfhost/Kernel.wiz (the self-hosted kernel) are independent programs. Neither imports the other and no scanned module imports both.
entries.owner: Scry fixpoint analysis (lib/Scry/AiFixpoint.wiz) and the self-hosted kernel (selfhost/Kernel.wiz)
